cohort: 281 parturients (142 with FGM, 139 without FGM) in Jijiga town, Ethiopia, recruited between October and December 2014
finding: Women with FGM, particularly type III, experience significantly increased risks of adverse obstetric outcomes compared to those without FGM.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was significantly associated with FGM overall and specifically with FGM type III.
